name: readonly-agent-gate
description: PreToolUse hook that limits the read-only agents (architect, reviewer, debugger, plus any you list) to Bash commands that don't write outside /tmp and the session scratchpad. Needs bun.

extra_agents.title: Extra read-only agents
extra_agents.description: More agent types to gate, separated by commas or spaces. A bare name (security-auditor) also matches any plugin's agent of that name; a scoped name (security-auditor:security-auditor) matches only itself.
